candidates.name: Samawa Refinery–Samawa Combined-Cycle Power Plant Fuel Oil Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Iraq's Oil Pipelines Company (with State Company for Oil Projects / SCOP)

evidence.note: Oil Pipelines Company brought online a 6 km, 6-inch fuel oil pipeline linking Samawa Refinery to Samawa Combined-Cycle Power Plant, with pumping station at the refinery and receiving station at the plant, replacing tanker-truck delivery.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row connects a Muthanna-province refinery to a power plant; closest analogues in scope are the already-tracked refinery/pipeline-to-power-plant lines (Ahdeb–Wassit P5292/P5293, Strategic Pipeline–Musaiab P6254, Strategic Pipeline–Al-Khairat P6258), none of which touch Samawa. Small diameter/length but same class as those existing operating rows, and independently sourced/dated (2025-04), so not a duplicate under another name.
